# Unit4 integrated review pack

> Resource packaged with textbook edition 0.48 (14 October 2026): 50 draft chapters across Units 1–4; all four editorial coverage maps are available. Independent review and learner evidence remain pending. Original authoring dates below are provenance, not new sign-off; teacher keys are separate but not access-protected.

Use the review schema/seed; do not mix with the earlier seed. Standard-library Python 3 and SQLite. Run unit4-review-runner.py from any folder with sibling files retained. It creates only an in-memory database and checks supplied reference SQL; it does not check learner ownership, production security or crash durability. Write/test independent queries first. Reference files and teacher answers are not access-protected.
Twelve files provide optional workbook questions, a mixed-practice worksheet and explained answers across eight lessons in Weeks 11–12. There are no marks or submissions. Teacher review of symbols, sources and explanations remains useful. All data fictional. Legal assumptions/date matter; checked 14 October 2026. Next: full-course consolidation and targeted repair in Weeks 13–14.
